name: Free AI Tool

sources.title: Homepage — live curated directory of free AI tools; FAQ says the team curates tools; contact email andy@freeaitool.ai in footer

requirements: Only free AI tools are listed ('the best free AI tools... at zero cost'); freemium entries exist but the positioning is no-cost tools
No public submission form — curation is done by their team; the only intake is the footer contact email andy@freeaitool.ai
Listing pages show monthly-visit estimates and a pricing tag (100% Free / Freemium / Free Trial)
preparation: Product name, URL, short description, and the free-tier story
A concise pitch email to andy@freeaitool.ai explaining the free offering
Fitting category (writing, image, video, code, voice, marketing, chatbot, etc.)
workflow: Draft a pitch email to andy@freeaitool.ai with product name, URL, description, and free-tier details
Reference the directory's format (tool pages carry tagline, description, pricing tag, monthly visits)
Follow up once if no response — no SLA exists
watchFor: Paid-only or primarily-paid products are off-positioning — the directory is 'free AI tools'
No self-serve intake; listing is entirely at the curator's discretion
Some listed tools are thinly veiled wrappers; bar appears low but thematic fit matters
NSFW-adjacent categories exist (face swap, baby generator) — check category adjacency
countsAsLive: The tool has a public /tool/<slug> page on freeaitool.ai appearing in New Added or its category
unknowns: Whether they charge for listings — no pricing mentioned anywhere
